name: Cloud-Leap (Split-Step)
summary: Reactive split-step timing for first-move acceleration. Master the foundational ready position that lets you explode in any direction.
quick_drills: Partner drop: Split-step when your partner drops the ball.
Audio cue: Split-step on the sound of contact.
common_errors: Landing on flat feet instead of the balls of the feet.
Mistiming the hop before the opponent strikes.

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete stands in a neutral ready stance with feet about shoulder width apart, knees softly bent, weight on the balls of the feet, paddle centered in front of the chest.
phases.teaching_focus: Show a true ready position before the split step begins.
phases.camera: Medium-wide front three-quarter shot showing full lower body and ready posture.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: As the opponent strikes the ball, the athlete performs a quick split step: a small simultaneous hop with both feet leaving the ground briefly, then landing softly on the balls of the feet with hips level and torso upright.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the split step as a quick timing hop, not a squat.
phases.camera: Side tracking medium shot focused on feet, ankles, knees, and hip level.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: Immediately after landing, the athlete loads one leg and pushes explosively into the first lateral movement step while the core stays stable and the upper body remains quiet.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the split step creating a fast directional reaction.
phases.camera: Tracking side shot following the push-off and first acceleration step.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: The athlete arrives in a balanced defensive stance with feet re-centered, knees flexed, paddle ready in front, and eyes forward.
phases.teaching_focus: Show a clean reset into court-ready posture.
phases.camera: Static wide shot showing the full-body recovery position.

name: Golden Hinge (Dink)
summary: The foundation of the non-volley zone. A compact, shoulder-driven push-contact that neutralizes the pace and keeps the ball low.
quick_drills: Target practice: Hit 10 dinks in a row into a hula hoop.
Wall dinks: Continuous soft contact against a wall.
common_errors: Standing too upright (lack of leg engagement).

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete settles into a low athletic stance with paddle centered in front of the body and shoulders relaxed.
phases.teaching_focus: Show a calm prepared stance that reduces wrist noise.
phases.camera: Medium shot framed from chest to paddle.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: Small shuffles move the body behind the ball while the paddle remains stable and slightly open.
phases.teaching_focus: Show controlled positioning before contact.
phases.camera: Tracking medium shot following the torso and paddle alignment.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: Single soft push-contact sends the ball forward with a compact low-to-high motion and minimal follow-through.
phases.teaching_focus: Show one clean touch and avoid extra swing motion.
phases.camera: Close side shot at contact level on paddle, ball, and forearm.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Athlete returns to a low neutral stance with paddle centered and knees ready.
phases.teaching_focus: Show immediate readiness after the dink.
phases.camera: Static wide shot showing the full recovery shape.

name: Heavenly Arc (Slice Drop)
summary: A high-to-low carving path that creates backspin and a shallow bounce. Perfect for dropping the ball into the kitchen from the baseline.
quick_drills: Bucket drops: Drop 20 balls into a bucket in the kitchen.
Partner feed: Practice from the baseline while a partner feeds.
common_errors: Closing the paddle face (hitting the net).

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Paddle rises high with the torso coiled and the face slightly open to prepare for a controlled slice.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the setup for a downward carving path.
phases.camera: Medium shot on torso, shoulder, and paddle face angle.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: The shoulder leads a smooth high-to-low carve while the wrist stays quiet and the paddle path stays linear.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the shoulder-driven descent clearly.
phases.camera: Tracking medium shot following the paddle path downward.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: One clean underside contact brushes the ball once to create slice and backspin.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the exact brushing moment and avoid repeated contact.
phases.camera: Close-up on paddle-ball contact from the side.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Athlete shifts forward slightly and settles into a low balanced stance after contact.
phases.teaching_focus: Show a controlled finish and move into the next ready position.
phases.camera: Static wide shot with full-body follow-through and recovery.

name: Stone Wall (Block)
summary: A compact defensive wall that absorbs pace from hard drives. Minimal motion, maximum absorption.
quick_drills: Rapid fire: Block 10 consecutive drives from a partner at the net.
Reflex block: Reaction drills with a ball machine.

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete holds a compact ready stance with the paddle centered at chest height and eyes forward.
phases.teaching_focus: Show a compact defensive posture with minimal motion.
phases.camera: Medium shot at chest level.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: The paddle shifts only slightly toward the incoming ball while the grip stays relaxed and the body stays still.
phases.teaching_focus: Show anticipation and small adjustments.
phases.camera: Tracking medium shot on paddle line and incoming ball path.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: One soft absorption block deadens the ball with a small recoil and no extra paddle movement.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the single absorbing contact and the recoil.
phases.camera: Close-up on paddle face and forearm at contact.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Athlete returns the paddle to center and holds a balanced defensive stance.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the quick recovery after the block.
phases.camera: Static wide shot showing the whole reset position.

name: Precision Snap (Volley)
summary: A decisive forward strike with immediate stabilization. Controlled linear power for finishing points at the net.
quick_drills: Volley battle: Engage in a fast volley rally at the kitchen.
Step-in volleys: Practice stepping into the volley for power.
common_errors: Failing to reset to a neutral stance.

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete sets an aggressive forward stance with weight slightly on the front foot and paddle compact.
phases.teaching_focus: Show offensive pressure without over-rotating.
phases.camera: Medium shot on upper body and front-foot pressure.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: A short step forward creates linear extension while the torso stays mostly square to the target.
phases.teaching_focus: Show linear forward power and control.
phases.camera: Tracking medium shot following the step and torso line.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: One crisp volley contact sends the ball forward with a short, compact strike and immediate stop.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the decisive contact point and compact finish.
phases.camera: Close-up side shot at paddle-ball contact.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Athlete snaps back to center with a balanced athletic base and ready paddle position.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the fast defensive reset.
phases.camera: Static wide shot of the recovery stance.

name: Mountain Peak (Power Drive)
summary: Full-body kinetic chain power. A heavy drive that uncoils from the ground up to overwhelm opponents.
quick_drills: Ground-up focus: Practice driving the ball from a static position.
Full swing target: Drive balls into a target area on the baseline.

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete coils into a strong unit turn with weight on the back foot and shoulders fully loaded.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the full body loading phase clearly.
phases.camera: Wide shot showing feet, hips, torso, and shoulder line.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: Hips begin the uncoil while the arm lag behind, creating a clear kinetic chain from the ground upward.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the sequence of force transfer through the body.
phases.camera: Tracking medium shot from hips through torso to paddle.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: A power vertical paddle face drives the ball forward with while the body rotates forward with non paddle hand rotating with the body.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the exact impact moment.
phases.camera: Close-up on paddle face at contact.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Transitions from rotating hips after making contact with the ball until lands in balance on the front foot. Paddle arm extended and left hand out for balance.
phases.teaching_focus: Show safe deceleration and stable recovery.
phases.camera: Static wide shot showing the full balanced finish.

name: Aerial Switch (Overhead)
summary: Vertical extension and explosive downward power. Transition from tracking a lob to a dominant overhead smash.
quick_drills: Tracking drills: Move backward while tracking a high lob.
Smash target: Hit overheads into the opponent's feet area.

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete tracks the ball overhead while bending the knees, paddle in right hand, and loading the rear leg for a jump.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the prep for an overhead strike.
phases.camera: Wide shot that includes the descending ball and full body stance.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: The athlete explodes upward into a controlled leap as the shoulders and hips rotate toward the ball with right hand paddle rising up.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the jump and body rotation without over-stylizing it.
phases.camera: Medium tracking shot on the upward drive and torso rotation.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: Athlete paddle makes contact with the ball at the highest reachable point with the paddle fully extended.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the overhead strike at peak extension.
phases.camera: Close-up or tight medium on upper body, paddle, and ball at contact.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Athlete lands with paddle in right hand while softly, absorbs the impact through the legs, and returns to a neutral ready stance.
phases.teaching_focus: Show safe landing mechanics and reset.
phases.camera: Wide shot showing the landing and full recovery.

name: River Flow (Reset)
summary: Low-preparation touch to absorb extreme pace. A flowing reset that turns a defensive scramble back into a neutral rally.
quick_drills: Reset from baseline: Block drives from the baseline and drop into kitchen.
Touch drill: Practice varying height of resets.
common_errors: Insufficient hip drop (limiting reach and control).

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete lowers the hips and drops the paddle below knee height to prepare a soft reset.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the low preparation for control and touch.
phases.camera: Medium-low shot focused on knees, hips, and paddle.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: The paddle rises smoothly from the shoulder while the torso stays upright and quiet.
phases.teaching_focus: Show a smooth upward path without wrist collapse.
phases.camera: Medium tracking shot following the paddle lift.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: A single soft contact absorbs pace and sends the ball gently forward with no extra taps.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the pace absorption clearly.
phases.camera: Close-up on paddle face and ball contact.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Athlete steps back into a balanced stance with paddle ready in front of the body.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the transition back to defense.
phases.camera: Static wide shot showing the recovery posture.

name: Monkey Wing (Topspin Roll)
summary: Angular velocity and forearm rotation. An aggressive topspin dink or volley that rolls over the net with dipping action.
quick_drills: Shadow rolls: Practice the forearm rotation without a ball.
Topspin dinks: Hit rolling dinks against a partner.

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete closes the shoulder and drops the paddle below ball level in a compact backhand setup.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the coiled backhand preparation.
phases.camera: Medium shot on shoulder closure and paddle height.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: The hips uncoil and the forearm rotates upward to create a clear topspin path.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the transfer of angular velocity.
phases.camera: Tracking medium shot following the forearm and torso rotation.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: One upward brushing contact rolls over the ball and creates topspin with a compact finish.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the exact brushing contact once.
phases.camera: Close-up on paddle brushing the ball from the side.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: Athlete finishes high across the body and holds a balanced recovery stance.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the controlled end position.
phases.camera: Static wide shot showing the completed follow-through.

name: Infinite Reach (Lunge)
summary: Lateral extension and end-range stability. Master the deep lunge to retrieve wide balls without sacrificing core integrity.
quick_drills: Lunge reaches: Static lunges reaching as far as possible.
Sideline reaches: Practice reaching for balls near the sideline.
common_errors: Step is too short (lack of reach).
Failing to drive back to center.

phases.label: Loading
phases.action: Athlete initiates a deep lateral step while keeping the core tall and stable.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the setup for the lateral reach.
phases.camera: Wide tracking shot that shows the full step and body line.

phases.label: Transition
phases.action: The athlete lowers into a controlled lunge as the outside leg bends and the paddle arm extends.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the lowering phase and outside-leg support.
phases.camera: Wide or medium-wide tracking shot following the descent.

phases.label: Execution
phases.action: One contact is made at maximum reach with a stable torso and a firm but controlled wrist with paddle in hand.
phases.teaching_focus: Show end-range control without losing balance.
phases.camera: Close-up or tight medium on the outside knee, core, and paddle contact.

phases.label: Stabilization
phases.action: The athlete drives back to center and returns to a neutral ready stance.
phases.teaching_focus: Show the concentric recovery clearly.
phases.camera: Static wide shot showing the full recovery back to center court.
